note: A church could not create a service without first creating an event. THE-329 makes a service its own thing: `ServicePlan` gains ONE field, `startAt`, and the two-way invariant `isTemplate === (eventId === null)` becomes the three-way `isTemplate === (planKind(plan) === 'template')` over event-anchored · standalone · template. NO MIGRATION: every document already in a church's database has no `startAt`, reads as null, and lands in exactly the kind it already was. `firestore.rules` is BYTE-IDENTICAL and needs no change — the new field lives in the same collection, neither half of the deployed rule reads `resource.data`, and this ticket adds no query shape at all. `manageEvents` remains the permission. The two files below are the ones this ticket edits that the register already records; `ServiceCreateForm.tsx` is NEW IN THIS TICKET and is recorded here too so a later ticket that edits it fails in its own PR. `AdminDashboard.tsx` is NOT edited and NOT recorded: no nav array changed, because the Services section already exists and already carries the right gate.

entries.why: THE-329 OWNS THIS EDIT. THE-326 built this section and recorded its own known cost in this very docblock: "a church must still create an event before it can plan the service. That is the wrong order of operations for a weekly rhythm." The founder's words are the same finding — "If I have no event created, I cannot create any service, which is stupid" — so the cost is paid here. (1) The section now MOUNTS `ServiceCreateForm` and makes ONE write, through part 1's own `createServicePlan`; it still spells no `setDoc`/`addDoc`/`updateDoc`/`deleteDoc`/`writeBatch`, which THE-326's guard still asserts. (2) The service list is now event-anchored services AND standalone ones, merged and sorted in memory, newest first as before; the picker's value is a `kind:id` key rather than a bare event id, because two kinds share one list. (3) NO FIRESTORE QUERY IS ADDED — the standalone services come from `useRotaPlans`, the rota's existing `where('isTemplate','==',false)` read with `limit(N+1)`, which react-query dedupes with the rota tab's own call. That read reports `truncated`, and a truncated list SAYS SO rather than being presented as the whole diary. (4) A failed read now renders a FAILURE (`data-services-failed`), branched before emptiness — the Silent-Failure Rule; before this, a rejected events read rendered the same empty state as a church with no events. (5) The empty state no longer says "A service needs a dated event before it can be planned. Create one on the Events screen" — it points at the form above it. (6) `ServicePlanPanel` is handed `planId` alongside `eventId`. No new primitive is adopted here: `card`, `empty`, `select` and `tabs` were already this file's, and the form's own primitives are recorded against `ServiceCreateForm.tsx` in THE-272's and THE-274's adopter lists. No colour, no emoji, no inline style, no new token.

THE-329 OWNS THIS EDIT, AND IT IS THE SMALLEST ONE THAT MAKES A STANDALONE SERVICE PLANNABLE. `eventId` becomes `string | null` and a `planId` prop joins it: an event-anchored service is still FOUND by its event (`where('eventId','==',…)`, THE-313's query, unchanged — such a plan may not exist yet, so there is no id to hold), while a standalone service IS a plan document and is read by its own id through the new `useServicePlanById`. Both hooks are mounted unconditionally and exactly one is `enabled`, so a hook is never called conditionally and the NETWORK cost is still one read. `startPlan` returns early when there is no event — unreachable for a standalone service, whose plan is created by the Services section before this panel ever mounts — and builds its fields through `servicePlanFields` instead of an object literal, so the two-anchor pair cannot be spelled wrongly. Every `invalidate(...)` call gained the plan id. NOTHING ELSE MOVED: the drag and keyboard reorder, `itemClockTimes`, the run-sheet share payload (still no URL, still no `giving-share.ts` import), `saveAsTemplate`, `templateFromPlan` and the delete are untouched, and this file still imports nothing from `src/components/ui/`, so it adopts no primitive and no adopter list moves.

THE-329 — ONE React key, and nothing else in the file. A week's service row was keyed on `service.eventId`; a standalone service has no event, so the key is now the `(eventId, planId)` pair, which is unique for both kinds. The view persists nothing — it takes plain props and calls `onAssign` — and no prop, call, query, class, colour token or measured width moved. THE-326's two fixes to this file (the `w-full` tab list with no `min-w-` on the triggers, and the date selector formatting through `fmtDay` instead of printing a raw epoch) are untouched and their guards still pass.
